name: scoring-test
description: Taekwondo judge scoring test: instructor PC serves clips over LAN, trainees tap on phones.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.check: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
